rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a mobile phone.

example.english: I only realized when I left home that I had forgotten my mobile phone.
example.traditional: 我出門口先發現唔記得帶手機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 mun4 hau2 sin1 faat3 jin6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this familiar alternative when you want to be more explicit or slightly less casual than 手機.

example.english: Please set your mobile phone to silent; the meeting is about to begin.
example.traditional: 請將手提電話調校到靜音，會議就快開始。
example.jyutping: ceng2 zoeng1 sau2 tai4 din6 waa2 tiu4 gaau3 dou3 zing6 jam1 wui6 ji5 zau6 faai3 hoi1 ci2

rows.note: Use this formal or technical term in official, written, or telecommunications contexts.

example.english: Please enter your mobile phone number on the application form.
example.traditional: 申請表上請填寫流動電話號碼。
example.jyutping: san1 cing2 biu2 soeng6 ceng2 tin4 se2 lau4 dung6 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5
